narrative:
## Handover Summary — NBP Rate Scenarios

Three NBP paths have been approved for planning: base (3.50%), dovish (3.00%) and hawkish hold (4.00%).

## Key Decisions
- Current-account replicating portfolio yield raised on salary-account switching
- Warsaw mortgage NII lifted for periodic fixed-rate origination
- Ex-Citi private banking spread re-based to post-migration pricing

## Recommendation for Deposit Beta & Pricing
The dovish path is the binding constraint. Deposit pricing should target a blended beta at or below 42% to keep NIM above the 3.80% floor under that scenario.

## Risk Factors
- Faster-than-expected easing if CPI undershoots
- Behavioural model risk on ex-Citi balances

signals.title: NBP Monetary Policy Council — Rate Decision
signals.excerpt: The MPC lowered the reference rate and signalled further easing as CPI returns toward the 2.5% target. Market pricing implies a terminal rate near 3.50%.

signals.title: EBA IRRBB Supervisory Outlier Test
signals.excerpt: Banks must report ΔNII and ΔEVE under prescribed rate shocks; a ΔEVE decline above 15% of Tier 1 capital triggers supervisory dialogue.
